name: Rufous-winged Antshrike
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northeastern bolivia to northeastern paraguay and eastern and central brazil
description: Medium-sized antshrike. Males have black-and-white barring on the breast and tail and a black crown that fades to gray on the back.

name: Taita White-eye
rangeDescription: Southeastern kenya (taita hills)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the olive-green back, the yellow throat and undertail, and the ridiculously broad white spectacles around the eyes.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Crimson-breasted Gonolek
rangeDescription: Southwestern angola and namibia to botswana and northwestern south africa
description: A striking black-and-crimson bushshrike with a white stripe on its wing; a rare morph with yellow underparts also occurs. Singles and pairs forage alone or sometimes in mixed-species flocks in dry thornveld and dense tangles, where they prefer foraging on thicker trunks but will also forage on the open ground.

name: Brown Twinspot
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria southward to northern angola, eastward to southern south sudan, western uganda, and western kenya
description: An unusual, beautiful twinspot with a gray hood, a red rump, and a rufous breast and belly covered in white “twin spots.” Males have a red central throat stripe and females a white one. Found in areas with thick undergrowth, including lush savanna, overgrown cultivated areas, and forest edge.

name: Yellow-lored Bristlebill
rangeDescription: Southeastern nigeria to central african republic; bioko
description: An unusual and colorful rainforest bulbul. The upperparts are dark olive-green and the underparts yellow.

name: American Bittern
rangeDescription: Alaska to mexico; winters to panama and west indies
description: Stocky, brown heron found in marshes and bogs. Usually secretive and difficult to see, but occasionally found in the open.

name: Numfor Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Numfor (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small dull-colored warbler with an indistinct pale eyebrow, a dull greenish upperside, a pale throat, and dull yellowish underparts. Usually shows an indistinct wingbar.

name: Manchurian Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Northern manchuria; winters to southern china and thailand
description: Small, shy, and poorly understood, this reed warbler breeds in the remote marshlands of northeastern China and Russia and winters in drier, grassier habitats in Southeast Asia. Warm brown overall with a clean-cut whitish brow and throat; brow extends well behind the eye, unlike in Blunt-winged Warbler.

name: Hinde's Pied-Babbler
rangeDescription: Locally in foothill scrub of east-central kenya
description: A dark babbler with abundant scaly markings and red-orange eyes. The exact pattern and coloration are extremely variable.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Southern Cassowary
rangeDescription: Humid forest of northeastern australia, and new guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea)
description: Enormous flightless bird with dark glossy plumage and large, horn-like plate on colorful head with two red neck wattles. Unlikely to be confused with other species.

name: Golden Pipit
rangeDescription: Southeastern south sudan, southern and eastern ethiopia, somalia, northern uganda, eastern kenya, and eastern tanzania; partially nomadic or migratory
description: An unusual pipit of dry country. Breeding males are spectacular, with yellow underparts, a black chest band, and yellow wings with black tips.

name: Yungas Manakin
rangeDescription: Southeastern peru (cusco, southern madre de dios, and puno) and western bolivia
description: Fairly large manakin of montane forest habitats. Males are black with a blue back and red cap; females are dull olive green.

name: Gray-hooded Heleia
rangeDescription: Tree-fern forest of seram (southern moluccas)
description: A relatively large white-eye confined to Seram. Most conspicuous identification features are the complete gray hood, the white forehead, and the bright white eye-ring.

name: Nightingale Wren
rangeDescription: Humid southern mexico (northern chiapas) to central costa rica
description: Small, dark brown wren of humid evergreen forest in tropical lowlands and foothills; most often detected by its distinctive song. Usually stays low, on or near the forest floor in shady understory, and is difficult to see well.

name: Great Xenops
rangeDescription: Arid caatinga of interior northeastern and east-central brazil
description: Large and subtly beautiful xenops with a pointy curved bill. Has bright rusty plumage with a white throat.

name: Crested Hornero
rangeDescription: Chaco of southeastern bolivia to western paraguay and northern argentina
description: A mostly terrestrial and chunky light brown bird of the north and central Chaco, from central Argentina to Western Paraguay and extreme SE Bolivia. Distinguished from Rufous Hornero by crest, from Lark-like Brushrunner by plain plumage, and from Cachalotes by dull plumage, smaller bill and size, and dark iris.

name: Iraq Babbler
rangeDescription: Southern türkiye, syria, iraq, and southwestern iran (reedbeds of tigris-euphrates valley)
description: Small babbler with a long tail and short wings, typical of other babblers. Warm buff overall with a pale throat and a lightly streaked back and crown.

name: Broad-tailed Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern usa to mexico and guatemala
description: Common hummingbird of high elevations. Breeds in open woodland with meadows and scrub.

name: Sula Jungle Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu, seho, mangole, and sanana)
description: A nondescript brown flycatcher with a rufous tail and rump. Note the hook-tipped bill, white throat, and pale gray unstreaked underparts.

name: Morrison's Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Active small songbird, endemic to Taiwan. Brown above, white below, with gray head, large white eyering, thin black borders in crown (hard to see at times), and buffy wash in flanks.
